request.query: Transport the finite coefficient expansion of a univariate polynomial through an algebra equivalence, optionEquivLeft natDegree degreeOf none

items.name: MvPolynomial.natDegree_optionEquivLeft
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R),
  ((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) p).natDegree = MvPolynomial.degreeOf none p

items.name: MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv
items.type:
(R : Type u) →
  [inst : CommSemiring R] → (n : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft
items.type: (R : Type u) → (S₁ : Type v) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial (MvPolynomial S₁ R)

items.name: Polynomial.mapAlgEquiv_toAlgHom
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {A : Type z} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring A] [inst_2 : Semiring B]
  [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] (f : A ≃ₐ[R] B), ↑(Polynomial.mapAlgEquiv f) = Polynomial.mapAlgHom ↑f

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_eq_natDegree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (a : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf a p =
    ((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R { b // b ≠ a })
        ((MvPolynomial.rename ⇑(Equiv.optionSubtypeNe a).symm) p)).natDegree
